title: MPESB MP Police Subedar Stenographer Final Result 2026

shortDescription: MPESB has declared Final Result for MP Police Subedar (Stenographer) & ASI Recruitment Test 2025 on 17 July 2026. Check score and merit at esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board has released the FINAL RESULT of Subedar (Stenographer) & Assistant Sub-Inspector Recruitment Test – 2025 on 17 July 2026.

Documents on result page

  • Final Result Note
  • Final Cut-off & First Phase Cut-off
  • Top 10 list
  • Merit List (ASI) & Merit List (Subedar)
  • Marks Details for both posts

Candidates can check individual status via login on esb.mp.gov.in.
